name: Fujii Shizuku
source:
Shizuku plays the drums in Rock Band Club and is a newscaster for the school's radio along with [url=/c98241]Misaki[/url]. Just like [url=/c98205]Ruka[/url], Shizuku is learning how to be a chuunibyou from [url=/c98206]Suzu[/url].
